summary: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in the securities that comprise the index, which will primarily include U.S. Treasury securities and long-dated call options ("LEAP Options") on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust ("SPY"). The index is a rules-based, quantitative index that seeks to provide capital protection against the unpredictable, rare and highly disruptive events that have come to be referred to as "Black Swans."
